description: ltl-persistence hooks. PreCompact: tell the compaction summary exactly which handoff file to point at and whether it is fresh, stale or missing. SessionStart: after a compact, resume, clear or startup, report the touched projects' handoffs and inline the primary one. Stop: block the end of a turn once while a project this session wrote to has a missing or stale handoff. All three are fail-open and read-only except the small state file under ~/.claude/ltl-persistence/.
